property_summary: For any caller and inputs, calling newGrantProposal increments proposalCount by 1 in the reference contract (so proposalCount_new == proposalCount_old + 1); the mutant that omits the increment will violate this for some inputs (proposalCount unchanged).

For any call to newGrantProposal(recipient, amount) the reference increments proposalCount by exactly 1 (so proposalCount after the call equals prior+1); the mutant increments it by 2 for some inputs, breaking this invariant.
For any call to newGrantProposal(recipient, amount), the reference contract increases proposalCount by exactly 1 (post == pre + 1); the mutant increments it by 2 for some inputs, so post != pre + 1.

For any caller and any grant params, calling newGrantProposal increases proposalCount by exactly 1 in the reference contract; the mutant that decrements after increment can leave proposalCount unchanged and thus violates this rule for some inputs.

For any call to newGrantProposal(recipient, amount) the reference contract increments proposalCount by 1 (so proposalCount after the call equals previous+1); the mutant that immediately decrements can leave proposalCount unchanged, violating this invariant for some inputs.

For any caller and any params, calling newGrantProposal(...) always increases proposalCount by exactly 1 in the correct contract; the mutant that decrements immediately can leave proposalCount unchanged for some inputs, so there exists an input where proposalCount after the call is not previous+1.

For any caller and inputs, calling newGrantProposal(...) on the correct contract increases proposalCount by exactly 1 (post = pre + 1); the mutant that decrements after increment can leave proposalCount unchanged, so there exist inputs where this equality breaks.

For any caller and parameters, calling newGrantProposal increments proposalCount by 1 (post == pre + 1); the mutant that decrements immediately can leave proposalCount unchanged, violating this property for some inputs.
After init, the stored VADER address equals the first init parameter `_vader` (i.e., c.VADER() == _vader).
